'''Photomorph''' was an electronic entertainment device that took a photo of a user's face, then allowed them to distort the image in amusing ways. Several Photomorph booths were located in [[Astroport Interstellar Services]] at a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Paris only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Real Photomorph booths were found at the Astroport Interstellar Services arcade area, located after the exit of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride at [[Disneyland Paris]] from [[1993]] to [[2005]].<ref name="Lost Treasures">{{WebCite|url=https://www.designingdisney.com/content/lost-treasures-discoveryland|text=Lost Treasures - Discoveryland|work=Designing Disney|archivedate=20220303153751}}</ref>
